notes.title: Version Update
notes.notes:
Hello, Sir!
I'm Cheese Burger Studio's secretary Sato!

I'm back to report that we've added new features that I reported on before!!!
Yheee~♥

We are also preparing to add the Chinese language, so please ask for your interest and love.

Please refer to the report below for more details~★
Sato's report is over!

※ Ver. 1.00.00 → 1.01.00
· Skip function added
- The skip function has been added so that you can quickly turn the story and receive LUA's love.
- The skip button is located at the top left of the ingame.
- After click skip button, press another area again to cancel the skip.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257666/1189f73502dba8659a65f4771d565e68f75395a8.png

· 1st Event Scene Update
- When you first start Honey Trap, LUA's first event scene changed from camera move to Live 2D.
- You can also check out the changed event scene in the gallery.

notes.title: "Body Pay OMG!" Release date notice
notes.notes:
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44973741/6216eb3d793e3900cf67feaf5f689cb4e45db786.png
Hello, Sir!
I'm Cheese Burger Studio's secretary Sato!

Always a hardworking secretary, that Sato has good news!!!
Yay-★

The sequel to "Body Pay" that many sir have been asking about, "Body Pay OMG!", will be released on January 24, 2025 at 16:00 (PDT).
Ta-da!!!

Originally, it was going to be released as a DLC for "Body Pay", but since some users in countries including Korea were unable to use it, so we release it as a separate title.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3282510/Body_Pay/

"Body Pay OMG!" has a story mode consisting of a puzzle game and 12 stories, and a puzzle mode consisting of 20 puzzle games of various difficulty that you can collect Steam acheivement.
※ You must download the free DLC to enjoy the story and animation.

We'll come back with more good titles and news.
I ask for your interest and love!!!

Sato's report is over!
